docs.name: Admin Panel
docs.purpose: Set up your school's classes and connect people to them: create classes, put students in classes and assign teachers as primary or subject teachers.
steps: Open the Classes tab and press New Class.
Type the Class Name, for example Class 5, Nursery or LKG. This is required; nothing is saved without it.
Type the Section, for example A, B or C. If you leave it empty the section is set to A.
Press Create Class.
notes: You see Class created and the class appears in the list. Until you create one the list says No classes created yet.
problems: Assigning a subject teacher is refused. - Type the Subject, or change the Role to Primary Teacher.
Assigning a student is refused. - That student is already assigned to that class. Choose a different class if that was a mistake.
The Assign button is greyed out. - Choose a Class and a Student (or a Class and a Teacher) first.
taskTitles: Put a student in a class
Assign a teacher to a class
docs.content:
Admin Panel
Where: Left menu, Admin Panel.
What it is: Set up your school's classes and connect people to them: create classes, put students in classes and assign teachers as primary or subject teachers.
How to use it: (1) Open the Classes tab and press New Class. (2) Type the Class Name, for example Class 5, Nursery or LKG. This is required; nothing is saved without it. (3) Type the Section, for example A, B or C. If you leave it empty the section is set to A. (4) Press Create Class.
Good to know: You see Class created and the class appears in the list. Until you create one the list says No classes created yet.
If something goes wrong: Assigning a subject teacher is refused. - Type the Subject, or change the Role to Primary Teacher. Assigning a student is refused. - That student is already assigned to that class. Choose a different class if that was a mistake. The Assign button is greyed out. - Choose a Class and a Student (or a Class and a Teacher) first.

docs.name: Attendance
docs.purpose: Mark and review student attendance, and also staff attendance for teachers, drivers and bus attendants. Admins also get Attendance Risk. The tabs you see depend on your role.
steps: Open the Student Attendance tab and choose the class from Select class.
Choose the date, and the period if a Period box appears.
Set each student's status (Present, Absent, Late, Half Day or Excused), or press Mark all present and change the exceptions.
Press Save Attendance. Students you did not mark are skipped, and parents of marked students get an Attendance Update notification.
notes: You see Attendance saved, or a count of how many students were saved and how many are still unmarked.
problems: No teachers, drivers or attendants are listed. - The list is empty because no such staff exist for your school yet (the teacher and attendant tabs show matching messages).
The student list is empty. - That class and section has no active students. Check the class you chose.
You cannot see the Attendance Risk tab. - It is shown to teachers and admins only, so principals do not see it.
docs.content:
Attendance
Where: Left menu, Attendance.
What it is: Mark and review student attendance, and also staff attendance for teachers, drivers and bus attendants. Admins also get Attendance Risk. The tabs you see depend on your role.
How to use it: (1) Open the Student Attendance tab and choose the class from Select class. (2) Choose the date, and the period if a Period box appears. (3) Set each student's status (Present, Absent, Late, Half Day or Excused), or press Mark all present and change the exceptions. (4) Press Save Attendance. Students you did not mark are skipped, and parents of marked students get an Attendance Update notification.
Good to know: You see Attendance saved, or a count of how many students were saved and how many are still unmarked.
If something goes wrong: No teachers, drivers or attendants are listed. - The list is empty because no such staff exist for your school yet (the teacher and attendant tabs show matching messages). The student list is empty. - That class and section has no active students. Check the class you chose. You cannot see the Attendance Risk tab. - It is shown to teachers and admins only, so principals do not see it.

docs.name: Transport
docs.purpose: Manage school transport. Vehicles, drivers, attendants and routes (with their stops) each have their own tab, and each can be added, edited and deleted.
steps: Open the tab you need: Vehicles, Driver & Attendant, or Routes & Stops.
Press the matching Add button (Add Vehicle, Add Driver, Add Attendant or Add Route).
Fill in the form that opens and save it.
notes: You see Vehicle added, Driver added, Attendant added or Route added. Editing an existing record shows the same message with updated instead of added.
problems: A vehicle, driver or attendant cannot be deleted. - The record is probably in use by a route. Check the routes that use it before deleting.
Saving failed. - The page shows the error given by the system (the driver, attendant and route forms show matching messages). Check the form and save again.
A tab is empty. - Nothing has been added yet. Use the Add button on that tab (drivers and attendants show their own No ... added yet messages).
taskTitles: Add a vehicle, driver, attendant or route
docs.content:
Transport
Where: Left menu, Transport.
What it is: Manage school transport. Vehicles, drivers, attendants and routes (with their stops) each have their own tab, and each can be added, edited and deleted.
How to use it: (1) Open the tab you need: Vehicles, Driver & Attendant, or Routes & Stops. (2) Press the matching Add button (Add Vehicle, Add Driver, Add Attendant or Add Route). (3) Fill in the form that opens and save it.
Good to know: You see Vehicle added, Driver added, Attendant added or Route added. Editing an existing record shows the same message with updated instead of added.
If something goes wrong: A vehicle, driver or attendant cannot be deleted. - The record is probably in use by a route. Check the routes that use it before deleting. Saving failed. - The page shows the error given by the system (the driver, attendant and route forms show matching messages). Check the form and save again. A tab is empty. - Nothing has been added yet. Use the Add button on that tab (drivers and attendants show their own No ... added yet messages).
